Scenario: Submit a new contract for approval
Preconditions: Valid new contract; authenticated submitter exists
Test Steps: Submit new contract with action=submit; inspect approval step and audit event.
Expected Result: Redirect to /contracts; save PENDING step at Department / PMO review with contract and submitter links and timestamps; record APPROVAL UPDATE audit event.

Scenario: Save a new contract without submitting
Preconditions: Valid new contract; authenticated user
Test Steps: Register contract with action=save; inspect approval and audit interactions.
Expected Result: Redirect to /contracts; no approval step and no approval audit event.

Scenario: Resubmit a returned contract
Preconditions: Editable contract; latest approval is RETURNED with comment
Test Steps: Submit edited contract; inspect existing step.
Expected Result: Redirect to /contracts/100; reuse step; set PENDING and Resubmitted by Contract Creator; clear comment; update submitter and timestamp; audit RETURNED to PENDING.

Scenario: Resubmit after approval
Preconditions: Editable contract; latest approval is APPROVED
Test Steps: Submit edited contract; inspect old and new steps.
Expected Result: Keep old APPROVED record unchanged; create a separate PENDING step at Department / PMO review.

Scenario: Supersede duplicate pending steps
Preconditions: Editable contract; two PENDING steps ordered newest first
Test Steps: Submit edited contract; inspect both steps.
Expected Result: Newest remains PENDING; older becomes SUPERSEDED; save both steps.

Scenario: Approve a pending contract
Preconditions: Active reviewer; pending step; active contract status CS001 exists
Test Steps: POST /approvals/7/decision with decision=approved and comment with surrounding spaces.
Expected Result: Redirect to /approvals; step becomes APPROVED; comment trimmed; reviewer assigned; contract status and updater set; save step and contract; write audit.

Scenario: Reject without a comment
Preconditions: Active reviewer; pending step
Expected Result: Return HTTP 400; keep step PENDING; do not save step or write audit.

Scenario: Reject with a comment
Preconditions: Active reviewer; pending step
Test Steps: POST decision=REJECTED with comment Fix clause surrounded by spaces.
Expected Result: Redirect to /approvals; current step becomes REJECTED with trimmed comment; create a RETURNED step at Return to Contract Creator with same contract and comment; write audit.

Scenario: Department reviewer cannot decide another department contract
Preconditions: Reviewer department differs from contract department
Test Steps: POST approval decision as department reviewer.
Expected Result: Return HTTP 403; keep step PENDING; do not save or audit.

Scenario: Show filtered queue and newest history with counts
Preconditions: Active privileged reviewer; pending, returned, approved, rejected, and payment-updated records available
Test Steps: GET /approvals?q= acme ; inspect queue, history and counts.
Expected Result: Return approvals view; preserve query; queue count is 1; approved/rejected counts are 1 each; history is newest first and includes payment update

Scenario: Search with no matches
Preconditions: Active reviewer; repository returns records that do not match search
Expected Result: Return empty queue and history with pending count 0.

Scenario: Privileged reviewer queue uses all department scope
Preconditions: Active PMO reviewer
Expected Result: Return queue/history; repository queries use all-department scope for pending and decision history.

Scenario: Department reviewer is limited to own active department
Preconditions: Active reviewer assigned to department 8
Expected Result: Return queue/history; repository queries are restricted to department 8.

Scenario: Role without review permission sees empty queue
Preconditions: Active FINANCE reader
Expected Result: Return empty queue/history and pending count 0; do not query approval repository.

Scenario: Reviewer with inactive department sees empty queue
Preconditions: Active user has reviewer role but department is inactive
Expected Result: Return empty queue; do not query approval repository.

Scenario: Inactive or missing user cannot open queue
Preconditions: No active user found for employee code
Expected Result: Return HTTP 401.

Scenario: Inactive or missing user cannot decide approval
Preconditions: No active user found for employee code
Expected Result: Return HTTP 401; do not access approval or contract repositories or audit service.

Scenario: Reject unknown step and invalid decision
Preconditions: Active reviewer; step 7 exists and step 404 does not
Test Steps: POST decision to step 404; then POST decision=PENDING to step 7.
Expected Result: Unknown step returns HTTP 404; unsupported decision returns HTTP 400; do not save or audit.

Scenario: Reject missing decision malformed ID and unsupported method
Preconditions: No decision provided; malformed step ID; GET used on decision route
Test Steps: POST without decision; POST to /approvals/not-a-number/decision; GET /approvals/7/decision.
Expected Result: Return HTTP 400 for missing decision and malformed ID; return HTTP 405 for unsupported GET.

Scenario: Reject approval step without contract
Preconditions: Step exists and is PENDING but has no contract
Expected Result: Return HTTP 409; do not save step.

Scenario: Reject a step that was already decided
Preconditions: Step status is APPROVED
Expected Result: Return HTTP 409; do not save step.

Scenario: Same-department role alias can approve
Preconditions: Reviewer role is lowercase department_head; reviewer and contract departments match; active status exists
Expected Result: Approve step case-insensitively; clear absent comment; save contract.

Scenario: Approve a returned step
Preconditions: Step status is RETURNED; active contract status exists
Expected Result: Redirect to /approvals; set step APPROVED; save step and contract.

Scenario: PMO can approve across departments
Preconditions: Reviewer role PMO; reviewer and contract departments differ
Expected Result: Allow approval and save contract.

Scenario: CM can approve across departments
Preconditions: Reviewer role CM; reviewer and contract departments differ
Expected Result: Allow approval and save contract.

Scenario: ADMIN can approve across departments
Preconditions: Reviewer role ADMIN; reviewer and contract departments differ
Expected Result: Allow approval and save contract.

Scenario: HR can approve within own department
Preconditions: Reviewer role HR; departments match
Expected Result: Allow approval and save contract.

Scenario: DEPT_HEAD can approve within own department
Preconditions: Reviewer role DEPT_HEAD; departments match
Expected Result: Allow approval and save contract.

Scenario: DEPARTMENT_HEAD can approve within own department
Preconditions: Reviewer role DEPARTMENT_HEAD; departments match
Expected Result: Allow approval and save contract.

Scenario: APPROVER can approve within own department
Preconditions: Reviewer role APPROVER; departments match
Expected Result: Allow approval and save contract.

Scenario: Approval fails when active contract status is missing
Preconditions: Pending step; active contract status CS001 is unavailable
Expected Result: Return HTTP 500; approval step save is attempted before status resolution; contract is not saved. Test notes transaction rollback requires a transaction proxy.

Scenario: Returned step labels missing creator as System
Preconditions: Active ADMIN reviewer; contract has no creator
Expected Result: Create returned step with current approval label Return to System.

Scenario: FI role can view queue but cannot decide
Preconditions: FI reviewer belongs to contract department; pending record available
Expected Result: Queue includes pending record; decision is forbidden with HTTP 403.

Scenario: Escape special characters in audit comment
Preconditions: Active reviewer; pending step; active contract status exists
Test Steps: Approve with comment containing quote, backslash and newline; inspect audit JSON.
Expected Result: Redirect successfully; audit payload escapes quote

Scenario: Unauthenticated user cannot open approval queue
Preconditions: No authenticated session
Expected Result: Redirect to /login; approval and user repositories are not accessed.

Scenario: Unauthenticated user cannot submit approval decision
Preconditions: No authenticated session
Expected Result: Redirect to /login; approval/user repositories and audit service are not accessed.
